response.overview: As every year, the Dark Lord Sauron has awakened with the goal of destroying love on Valentine's Day. To stop the evil that threatens to destroy love in Middle-earth, the Fellowship of the Ring has sent two of its best men: Frodo Baggins and Samwise. However, between Sam's slow gait and Frodo's terrible sense of direction, they have ended up in Montcada's orchard, completely lost on their mission.
